title: Project Awesome
tagline: Project Awesome is a web3 photo-sharing app with privacy controls powered by Mantle and Kinto. Users can create albums, set access permissions, and enjoy a Web2-like UX with walletless logins. It bridges web 2 and web 3, offering secure, digital memory sharing for families.
